answerable.question: How many services are there?
answerable.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM services

answerable.question: List all tier 1 services.
answerable.sql: SELECT name FROM services WHERE tier = 1

answerable.question: Which team owns the search service?
answerable.sql: SELECT team FROM services WHERE name = 'search'

answerable.question: How many incidents are still open?
answerable.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE resolved_at IS NULL

answerable.question: List the open incidents with their service name.
answerable.sql: SELECT i.title, s.name FROM incidents i JOIN services s ON s.id = i.service_id WHERE i.resolved_at IS NULL

answerable.question: Which service had the most sev1 incidents?
answerable.sql: SELECT s.name FROM incidents i JOIN services s ON s.id = i.service_id WHERE i.severity = 'sev1' GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

answerable.question: How many incidents did each service have?
answerable.sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) FROM incidents i JOIN services s ON s.id = i.service_id GROUP BY s.name

answerable.question: How many sev1 incidents were there?
answerable.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE severity = 'sev1'

answerable.question: How many deploys failed?
answerable.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deploys WHERE status = 'failed'

answerable.question: List the deploys that were rolled back, with service name and version.
answerable.sql: SELECT s.name, d.version FROM deploys d JOIN services s ON s.id = d.service_id WHERE d.status = 'rolled_back'

answerable.question: What is the latest successfully deployed version of checkout?
answerable.sql: SELECT d.version FROM deploys d JOIN services s ON s.id = d.service_id WHERE s.name = 'checkout' AND d.status = 'succeeded' ORDER BY d.deployed_at DESC LIMIT 1

answerable.question: How many deploys happened in October 2026?
answerable.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deploys WHERE deployed_at LIKE '2026-10%'

answerable.question: Which services had a failed deploy in the last 30 days?
answerable.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM deploys d JOIN services s ON s.id = d.service_id WHERE d.status = 'failed' AND date(d.deployed_at) >= date('2026-11-18', '-30 days')

answerable.question: What was the total cost of all services in October 2026?
answerable.sql: SELECT SUM(usd) FROM costs WHERE month = '2026-10'

answerable.question: What did the payments team spend in October 2026?
answerable.sql: SELECT SUM(c.usd) FROM costs c JOIN services s ON s.id = c.service_id WHERE s.team = 'payments' AND c.month = '2026-10'

answerable.question: Which service cost the most in November 2026?
answerable.sql: SELECT s.name FROM costs c JOIN services s ON s.id = c.service_id WHERE c.month = '2026-11' ORDER BY c.usd DESC LIMIT 1

answerable.question: What is the total cost per team for November 2026?
answerable.sql: SELECT s.team, SUM(c.usd) FROM costs c JOIN services s ON s.id = c.service_id WHERE c.month = '2026-11' GROUP BY s.team

answerable.question: Which service's cost grew the most from October to November 2026?
answerable.sql: SELECT s.name FROM costs n JOIN costs o ON o.service_id = n.service_id AND o.month = '2026-10' JOIN services s ON s.id = n.service_id WHERE n.month = '2026-11' ORDER BY n.usd - o.usd DESC LIMIT 1

answerable.question: What is the average monthly cost of the search service?
answerable.sql: SELECT AVG(c.usd) FROM costs c JOIN services s ON s.id = c.service_id WHERE s.name = 'search'

answerable.question: How many incidents did the payments team have?
answerable.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents i JOIN services s ON s.id = i.service_id WHERE s.team = 'payments'

answerable.question: List the sev1 incidents of tier 1 services.
answerable.sql: SELECT i.title FROM incidents i JOIN services s ON s.id = i.service_id WHERE i.severity = 'sev1' AND s.tier = 1

answerable.question: How many minutes did the 'Login failures for SSO users' incident take to resolve?
answerable.sql: SELECT (julianday(resolved_at) - julianday(started_at)) * 24 * 60 FROM incidents WHERE title = 'Login failures for SSO users'

answerable.question: Which resolved incident took the longest to resolve?
answerable.sql: SELECT title FROM incidents WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY julianday(resolved_at) - julianday(started_at) DESC LIMIT 1

answerable.question: How many incidents started in November 2026?
answerable.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE started_at LIKE '2026-11%'

answerable.question: Which services have no open incidents?
answerable.sql: SELECT name FROM services WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT service_id FROM incidents WHERE resolved_at IS NULL)

answerable.question: Which services have never had a failed deploy?
answerable.sql: SELECT name FROM services WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT service_id FROM deploys WHERE status = 'failed')

answerable.question: How many deploys did each team make?
answerable.sql: SELECT s.team, COUNT(*) FROM deploys d JOIN services s ON s.id = d.service_id GROUP BY s.team

answerable.question: Which incidents started within one hour after a deploy of the same service?
answerable.sql: SELECT DISTINCT i.title FROM incidents i JOIN deploys d ON d.service_id = i.service_id WHERE julianday(i.started_at) >= julianday(d.deployed_at) AND julianday(i.started_at) - julianday(d.deployed_at) <= 1.0 / 24

answerable.question: What is the most recent incident?
answerable.sql: SELECT title FROM incidents ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1

answerable.question: How many sev3 incidents are still open?
answerable.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE severity = 'sev3' AND resolved_at IS NULL
